card.name: Linking words in birth-defect lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (of, and, including, a comma, an opening bracket) that come right before the next item in a list of congenital malformations or newborn findings, in pregnancy and infant exposure text.

modes.label: Link before next defect
modes.description: A connector such as 'and' or 'including' sits between named heart or birth defects.
modes.example: ventricular septal defects (VSDs)<< and>> atrial septal defects (ASDs

modes.label: Before a qualifier or category
modes.description: A word like 'overall' or 'of' comes just before the type of malformation or screening is named.
modes.example: whether there was an increased risk of<< overall>>, cardiovascular, or specific congenital mal

modes.label: Comma or bracket in a list
modes.description: Punctuation separates conditions in a list of defects.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly Chinese words and unrelated terms, so no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the small joining words and punctuation that lead into the next birth defect in a list.
